mapper.sql: CAST(record.receivable_id AS CHAR) AS record_id, 'RECEIVABLE' AS kind, record.receivable_no AS number, CAST(record.planned_amount AS CHAR) AS planned_amount, CAST(record.received_amount AS CHAR) AS received_amount, CAST(record.outstanding_amount AS CHAR) AS outstanding_amount, record.due_date, record.received_date, record.status

record.receivable_id AS id, record.tenant_id, record.customer_id, customer.customer_name, customer.status AS customer_status, record.version, record.portal_public_version, record.portal_published_by, record.portal_published_time, record.portal_file_ids,
crm_receivable record JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = record.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = record.customer_id AND customer.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE record.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND record.receivable_id = #{id} AND record.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sys_portal_user portal_user JOIN crm_contact contact ON contact.tenant_id = portal_user.tenant_id AND contact.contact_id = portal_user.ref_biz_id AND contact.customer_id = portal_user.customer_id JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.tenant_id = portal_user.tenant_id WHERE portal_user.tenant_id = #{identity.tenantId} AND portal_user.portal_user_id = #{identity.portalUserId} AND portal_user.customer_id = #{identity.customerId} AND portal_user.ref_biz_id = #{identity.contactId} AND portal_user.user_type = 'CUSTOMER_CONTACT' AND portal_user.ref_biz_type = 'CRM_CONTACT' AND portal_user.status = 'ACTIVE' AND portal_user.deleted = 0 AND portal_user.session_version = #{identity.sessionVersion} AND contact.version = #{identity.contactVersion} AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE' AND contact.deleted = 0 AND customer.status = 'ACTIVE' AND customer.deleted = 0 AND tenant.status = '0' AND tenant.deleted = 0 AND (tenant.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

record.tenant_id = #{identity.tenantId} AND record.customer_id = #{identity.customerId} AND record.deleted = 0 AND record.portal_public_version = record.version AND record.portal_published_by IS NOT NULL AND record.portal_published_time IS NOT NULL AND record.portal_file_ids IS NOT NULL AND customer.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE AND LOCATE(#{keyword}, record.receivable_no) > 0 ORDER BY record.receivable_id DESC
mapper.sql: file.file_id, file.file_name, file.file_size, file.file_type AS extension

file.tenant_id = record.tenant_id AND file.biz_type = 'PORTAL_FINANCE_RECEIVABLE' AND file.biz_id = CAST(record.receivable_id AS CHAR) AND file.access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND file.portal_owner_id IS NULL AND file.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM JOIN sys_file file ON WHERE AND record.receivable_id = #{id} AND JSON_CONTAINS(record.portal_file_ids, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(file.file_id AS CHAR))) ORDER BY file.file_id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_receivable SET portal_public_version = version + 1, portal_published_by = #{userId}, portal_published_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, portal_file_ids = #{files}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{userName}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receivable_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE crm_receivable SET portal_public_version = NULL, portal_published_by = NULL, portal_published_time = NULL, portal_file_ids = NULL, version = version + 1, update_by = #{userName}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receivable_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
